text: The clothes I like the best aren’t necessarily the\nmost flattering. It’s a real struggle.
I’m looking for something that’ll make me stand\nout even in a vast Wild Area.
I say there’s no such thing as youth fashion or\nold people’s fashion—only good fashion.

My gran told me I needed to go on a journey,
but a girl needs a bit of joy in her life, too!\c
Are you to here to do some shopping as well?
Don’t forget to register at the stadium![VAR 0114(000B)]
